creates:
{
  "schema": "spatial.typology.construction-from-2-points/v1",
  "note": "How a typology's construction (`construction.from2PointsAndHeight` in its `spatial.typology` asset) reads two picked points A, B and a height h into a plan: `prism` (origin, unit xAxis/yAxis, extents along xAxis/yAxis/+z), `cylinder` (base, radius, height along +z), `quad` (4 corners, right-handed normal), `line` (start, end). Every implementation (TS planner, Rust planner, each kernel's realisation, OpenCascade) answers these vectors; refusals are `construction.degenerate-input`.",
  "units": {
    "length": "metre",
    "up": "z",
    "handedness": "right"
  },
  "tolerance": 1e-09,
  "cases": [
    {
      "id": "wall-along-x",
      "note": "the bug vector: an axis-aligned wall gets the typology thickness, not a zero-depth bounding box",
      "construction": {
        "primitive": "solid",
        "profile": "segment",
        "thickness": 0.3,
        "alignment": "center"
      },
      "pointA": [
        0,
        0,
        0
      ],
      "pointB": [
        4,
        0,
        0
      ],
      "height": 2.7,
      "expect": {
        "kind": "prism",
        "origin": [
          0.0,
          -0.15,
          0.0
        ],
        "xAxis": [
          1.0,
          0.0,
          0.0
        ],
        "yAxis": [
          0.0,
          1.0,
          0.0
        ],
        "extents": [
          4.0,
          0.3,
          2.7
        ],
        "volume": 3.24,
        "bounds": {
          "min": [
            0.0,
            -0.15,
            0.0
          ],
          "max": [
            4.0,
            0.15,
            2.7
          ]
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "wall-diagonal-left",
      "note": "a 3-4-5 diagonal wall follows its baseline; left alignment puts the thickness on the left of A→B",
      "construction": {
        "primitive": "solid",
        "profile": "segment",
        "thickness": 0.3,
        "alignment": "left"
      },
      "pointA": [
        1,
        1,
        0
      ],
      "pointB": [
        4,
        5,
        0
      ],
      "height": 2.7,
      "expect": {
        "kind": "prism",
        "origin": [
          1.0,
          1.0,
          0.0
        ],
        "xAxis": [
          0.6,
          0.8,
          0.0
        ],
        "yAxis": [
          -0.8,
          0.6,
          0.0
        ],
        "extents": [
          5.0,
          0.3,
          2.7
        ],
        "volume": 4.05,
        "bounds": {
          "min": [
            0.76,
            1.0,
            0.0
          ],
          "max": [
            4.0,
            5.18,
            2.7
          ]
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "wall-diagonal-right",
      "note": "right alignment puts the thickness on the right of A→B",
      "construction": {
        "primitive": "solid",
        "profile": "segment",
        "thickness": 0.3,
        "alignment": "right"
      },
      "pointA": [
        1,
        1,
        0
      ],
      "pointB": [
        4,
        5,
        0
      ],
      "height": 2.7,
      "expect": {
        "kind": "prism",
        "origin": [
          1.24,
          0.82,
          0.0
        ],
        "xAxis": [
          0.6,
          0.8,
          0.0
        ],
        "yAxis": [
          -0.8,
          0.6,
          0.0
        ],
        "extents": [
          5.0,
          0.3,
          2.7
        ],
        "volume": 4.05,
        "bounds": {
          "min": [
            1.0,
            0.82,
            0.0
          ],
          "max": [
            4.24,
            5.0,
            2.7
          ]
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "door-baseline-at-a",
      "note": "the baseline is horizontal through A: B's elevation is not read",
      "construction": {
        "primitive": "solid",
        "profile": "segment",
        "thickness": 0.1,
        "alignment": "center"
      },
      "pointA": [
        0,
        2,
        1
      ],
      "pointB": [
        0,
        3,
        7
      ],
      "height": 2.1,
      "expect": {
        "kind": "prism",
        "origin": [
          0.05,
          2.0,
          1.0
        ],
        "xAxis": [
          0.0,
          1.0,
          0.0
        ],
        "yAxis": [
          -1.0,
          0.0,
          0.0
        ],
        "extents": [
          1.0,
          0.1,
          2.1
        ],
        "volume": 0.21,
        "bounds": {
          "min": [
            -0.05,
            2.0,
            1.0
          ],
          "max": [
            0.05,
            3.0,
            3.1
          ]
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "slab-rectangle",
      "note": "opposite footprint corners in any order, extruded by the height",
      "construction": {
        "primitive": "solid",
        "profile": "rectangle"
      },
      "pointA": [
        2,
        3,
        0
      ],
      "pointB": [
        -1,
        1,
        0
      ],
      "height": 0.25,
      "expect": {
        "kind": "prism",
        "origin": [
          -1.0,
          1.0,
          0.0
        ],
        "xAxis": [
          1.0,
          0.0,
          0.0
        ],
        "yAxis": [
          0.0,
          1.0,
          0.0
        ],
        "extents": [
          3.0,
          2.0,
          0.25
        ],
        "volume": 1.5,
        "bounds": {
          "min": [
            -1.0,
            1.0,
            0.0
          ],
          "max": [
            2.0,
            3.0,
            0.25
          ]
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "column-circle",
      "note": "centre A through B, extruded by the height",
      "construction": {
        "primitive": "solid",
        "profile": "circle"
      },
      "pointA": [
        1,
        1,
        0
      ],
      "pointB": [
        1.3,
        1.4,
        0
      ],
      "height": 3,
      "expect": {
        "kind": "cylinder",
        "base": [
          1.0,
          1.0,
          0.0
        ],
        "radius": 0.5,
        "height": 3,
        "volume": 2.356194490192,
        "bounds": {
          "min": [
            0.5,
            0.5,
            0.0
          ],
          "max": [
            1.5,
            1.5,
            3.0
          ]
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "external-wall-surface",
      "note": "a surface wall is the vertical face over its baseline — area |AB|·h, no thickness",
      "construction": {
        "primitive": "surface",
        "profile": "segment"
      },
      "pointA": [
        0,
        0,
        0
      ],
      "pointB": [
        4,
        0,
        0
      ],
      "height": 2.7,
      "expect": {
        "kind": "quad",
        "corners": [
          [
            0.0,
            0.0,
            0.0
          ],
          [
            4.0,
            0.0,
            0.0
          ],
          [
            4.0,
            0.0,
            2.7
          ],
          [
            0.0,
            0.0,
            2.7
          ]
        ],
        "normal": [
          0.0,
          -1.0,
          0.0
        ],
        "area": 10.8,
        "bounds": {
          "min": [
            0.0,
            0.0,
            0.0
          ],
          "max": [
            4.0,
            0.0,
            2.7
          ]
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "roof-surface-rectangle",
      "note": "a horizontal surface sits at the height above A, counter-clockwise from above",
      "construction": {
        "primitive": "surface",
        "profile": "rectangle"
      },
      "pointA": [
        5,
        4,
        0
      ],
      "pointB": [
        0,
        0,
        0
      ],
      "height": 3,
      "expect": {
        "kind": "quad",
        "corners": [
          [
            0.0,
            0.0,
            3.0
          ],
          [
            5.0,
            0.0,
            3.0
          ],
          [
            5.0,
            4.0,
            3.0
          ],
          [
            0.0,
            4.0,
            3.0
          ]
        ],
        "normal": [
          0.0,
          0.0,
          1.0
        ],
        "area": 20,
        "bounds": {
          "min": [
            0.0,
            0.0,
            3.0
          ],
          "max": [
            5.0,
            4.0,
            3.0
          ]
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "internal-wall-curve",
      "note": "a curve wall is its baseline lifted to the height",
      "construction": {
        "primitive": "curve",
        "profile": "segment"
      },
      "pointA": [
        0,
        0,
        0
      ],
      "pointB": [
        3,
        4,
        0
      ],
      "height": 3,
      "expect": {
        "kind": "line",
        "start": [
          0.0,
          0.0,
          3.0
        ],
        "end": [
          3.0,
          4.0,
          3.0
        ],
        "length": 5.0,
        "bounds": {
          "min": [
            0.0,
            0.0,
            3.0
          ],
          "max": [
            3.0,
            4.0,
            3.0
          ]
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "column-curve-point",
      "note": "a curve column is the vertical axis from A; B is not read",
      "construction": {
        "primitive": "curve",
        "profile": "point"
      },
      "pointA": [
        2,
        2,
        0
      ],
      "pointB": [
        9,
        9,
        9
      ],
      "height": 3,
      "expect": {
        "kind": "line",
        "start": [
          2.0,
          2.0,
          0.0
        ],
        "end": [
          2.0,
          2.0,
          3.0
        ],
        "length": 3,
        "bounds": {
          "min": [
            2.0,
            2.0,
            0.0
          ],
          "max": [
            2.0,
            2.0,
            3.0
          ]
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "refusals": [
    {
      "id": "coincident-segment",
      "note": "A and B coincide in plan: a baseline has no direction",
      "construction": {
        "primitive": "solid",
        "profile": "segment",
        "thickness": 0.3,
        "alignment": "center"
      },
      "pointA": [
        1,
        1,
        0
      ],
      "pointB": [
        1,
        1,
        5
      ],
      "height": 2.7,
      "code": "construction.degenerate-input"
    },
    {
      "id": "zero-height",
      "note": "nothing to extrude",
      "construction": {
        "primitive": "solid",
        "profile": "segment",
        "thickness": 0.3,
        "alignment": "center"
      },
      "pointA": [
        0,
        0,
        0
      ],
      "pointB": [
        4,
        0,
        0
      ],
      "height": 0,
      "code": "construction.degenerate-input"
    },
    {
      "id": "negative-height",
      "note": "a height is a length",
      "construction": {
        "primitive": "surface",
        "profile": "segment"
      },
      "pointA": [
        0,
        0,
        0
      ],
      "pointB": [
        4,
        0,
        0
      ],
      "height": -1,
      "code": "construction.degenerate-input"
    },
    {
      "id": "flat-rectangle",
      "note": "two corners on one axis span no footprint",
      "construction": {
        "primitive": "solid",
        "profile": "rectangle"
      },
      "pointA": [
        0,
        0,
        0
      ],
      "pointB": [
        5,
        0,
        0
      ],
      "height": 1,
      "code": "construction.degenerate-input"
    },
    {
      "id": "zero-radius",
      "note": "a circle through its own centre",
      "construction": {
        "primitive": "solid",
        "profile": "circle"
      },
      "pointA": [
        1,
        1,
        0
      ],
      "pointB": [
        1,
        1,
        0
      ],
      "height": 3,
      "code": "construction.degenerate-input"
    }
  ]
}
